positions.title: Founder
positions.description: Pucky is an IoT doorman and mobile app that empowers tenants to let the right people into their building from anywhere on earth. Just affix the puck-like device to your front door and you’re freed up to never wait by said door again – or miss packages, give your keys to dog walkers, cleaners, and other incredibly helpful people in your life. Coming soon at pucky.io

positions.title: Associate Consultant
positions.description:
- Due diligence for international M&A
- Strategy for Consumer, Retail, Tech, and Services companies

positions.title: Strategy and Business Operations
positions.description: I work with client's team to identify internal business operations inefficiencies, communicate with all stakesholder (from senior leadership to the sales team) to find opportunity areas, and create new workflow and processes to create opportunities from previous problems. For example: 1) I created an RFP template for commercial enterprises, shortening the RFP writing process by at least 3x; 2) I created a self-updating Excel quoting tool for the entire salesforce, resulting in quote turnover time shortening by at least 8x.

positions.title: Product Strategy & Marketing Intern
positions.description:
I started working with BlackBerry (AtHoc Division) as a Product Strategy and Marketing intern. After my internship, the BlackBerry team retains me as an independent consultant to support all aspects of the team's business strategy and operations from my college.

I work with the Athoc team on a variety of strategy project. For example, I conduct competitive research, create battlecard templates, identify key competitors and market trends, then communicate results to senior leadership and key stakeholders (sales team, marketing team, etc.). This research allows the client to strategically move from focusing domestically to being competitive internationally.
